Name: JerryBB's Bubble Valley
Author: JerryBBS2
Description:
Description
Bubbly, sparkly bath time in Stardew Valley! Wash up in rivers, ponds, the sea, the bathhouse, and your very own bathtubs and showers at home. Aurora-tinted foam bubbles up while you wash, and a soft sparkle stays with you for the rest of the day. Then blow a giant soap bubble, climb inside and float around the valley!

Installation instructions
1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.
2. Unzip the file and put the "JerryBB's Bubble Valley" folder into your Mods folder. It contains both the C# mod and the content pack.
3. Run the game!

[Main features]
Shampoo, Conditioner and Bath Bombs (6 scents)
- Mint Jasmine, Ocean Shell, Moonlight, Starlight, Cherry Blossom and Citrus
- Use them near water for a washing animation and a buff that lasts all day
- Shampoo and conditioner bottles last 10 uses, with a fill gauge
- Match the same scent for a set bonus
- Villagers notice when you've freshened up

Lotion, Toner and Mist (18 skincare items)
- Pat your cheeks or spritz a scented mist anywhere
- Stacks with your bath buffs, up to 6 buffs at once

6 Bathtubs (Robin's Carpenter Shop)
- Crystal, Sakura Ribbon, Moonlight, Starlight, Lily of the Valley and Citrus, in medium and large
- The tub fills with water and foam, and you change into your swimsuit
- Bath bombs color the water, and you whistle a little tune while you relax
- Two players can share a tub in multiplayer

Wall Showers in 6 colors (Pierre's General Store)
- Hot, warm or cold water
- Your farmer reacts to the season: shivering in cold winter water, hopping around in hot summer water
- The right temperature brings seasonal petals, leaves or snowflakes and a bonus
- Pick a shampoo or conditioner from your bag under the water
- Stand still under the water and you'll start whistling

Bubble Toys and Giant Bubbles
- 6 bubble toys to blow bubbles by the water
- Cloud, Crescent Moon and Jewel Box giant bubbles you can ride around the valley
- Press B while riding to play in zero gravity: somersaults, floating upside down and more
- Ride with your spouse, your kids, or up to 4 friends
- Villagers gasp as you float by

Wet Hair, Hair Dryers and Colds
- Your hair stays wet after washing. Dry it with a hair dryer (6 colors)
- Sleep with wet hair and you might catch a cold. Harvey's clinic sells medicine
- Never use a hair dryer in the bath. Harvey will have words with you!

Also
- Display Bubble Valley items on tables
- Foam finds your farmer's real head height automatically (body retextures, hats and Fashion Sense included)
- High-resolution art
- Multiplayer and split-screen supported (every player needs the mod)
- English and Korean
- Many options in Generic Mod Config Menu

Requirements
- Stardew Valley 1.6.9 or later
- SMAPI 4.1.0 or later
- Content Patcher 2.0.0 or later
- Generic Mod Config Menu (optional)

Shout outs
Thank you to ConcernedApe for Stardew Valley, Pathoschild for SMAPI and Content Patcher, and spacechase0 for Generic Mod Config Menu. And thank you for playing! If you find a bug, please share your SMAPI log (smapi.io/log).

AI disclosure
Some of the artwork and the promotional images on this page were made with the help of AI image tools, then edited and finished by hand.
